set.body: Source of truth: prd.json. Deliver mesh4s 0.1 as an immutable, identity-safe, oriented triangular 2-manifold core with boundary and disconnected components, paired with typed realizations, intrinsic metrics, locus4s fields, persistence, graph projections, and a focused ScalaFIM vertical slice. Complete only when RC-001 through RC-009 pass, all retained P0 and P1 requirements are closed, and fresh-checkout JVM, Scala.js, documentation, determinism, allocation, and consumer gates pass. Excludes silent repair, canonical nonmanifold meshes, general cell complexes, editing, and operator suites.
set.title: mesh4s 0.1 lawful triangulated-surface core
